name: Code Review
description: Automatic self-review after each code write — 3 perspectives before human review.

then.prompt: Quick self-review in 3 perspectives: 1) ENGINEER: follows code-conventions.md? Duplication? Correct imports? 2) SECURITY: per security-policies.md — secrets? SQL injection? 3) QA: null/empty inputs? Error handling? Edge cases? If problem found: fix NOW. If all good: silence.
